answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow for self-serve SMB accounts: it improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. Avoid matching the competitor with promotional pricing because the recovered evidence shows a 12% retention decline and failure through first renewal despite near-term acquisition gains. This is the strongest evidenced option for sustainable long-term qualified revenue, although it may not fully address price-driven churn among existing accounts.
